## 51db77fe24c5

**Issue found: finite distractor-mask shortcut.** Across 900 generated draws, every non-square blue distractor had one of only three normalized masks: horizontal length-4 line, a fixed four-cell L, or a fixed three-cell L. The canonical data contains three additional non-square masks never emitted by the generator: a vertical length-3 line, a vertical length-4 line, and a T tetromino.

A wrong solver can therefore memorize the three generated distractor masks and recolor every other blue component red. It matches every generated lesson but wrongly recolors those unseen canonical non-square objects. This is reproducible in `checks/audit-manual-evidence.json`.

Supporting findings: static lint fails on missing `RULE_HASH`; the semantic gate reports `NO_CONTRACT`. The profile floor itself passes, demonstrating why marginal profile coverage does not catch the shortcut.
